svg.title: Zaroori Baat illustrated architecture
svg.desc: A hand-drawn, four-stage architecture board: Slack signals, orchestrator, judgement, and human-reviewed outcomes.
svg.text: Zaroori Baat — How One Slack Message Runs
Fast deterministic triage, optional AI enrichment, always human-controlled
Slack Events API · bounded history sync · local API
Signed webhooks · channel filters · ID deduplication
Secrets remain in .env, never in the UI
LIVE EVENT: QUEUED INBOX ROW IN SECONDS
Deterministic core works without external services
Approval / decision needed · High / Medium / Low
Keywords, thread, and local SQLite vector RAG
RISK CASES REQUIRE HUMAN REVIEW · ACTION = NONE
Inbox, Message Detail, Action Items, Decision Memory
SQLite messages, workflow runs, local embeddings
LangSmith traces agents; Mem0 stores approved memory
No automatic reply, approval, or external action
PEOPLE REVIEW; THE APPLICATION RECORDS EVIDENCE
signal · context · actions · decision · safety · latency
Human review before action · fail closed
Zaroori Baat supports decisions from Slack conversations. It prioritizes and records context, but never sends messages or acts autonomously.
